correctness.rationale: Two full exact checkers establish all 2048 forcing candidates, via independent direct closure and 558-fort hitting calculations, obtaining exactly 114 size-five optima. All optima have bipartition signature 3+2, which forbids each slide. All 540 jumping edges and 6441 pairwise shortest distances agree by BFS and Floyd–Warshall, and the six maximum-Johnson-excess pairs are one orbit under the computed 12 graph automorphisms. Actual certificate files are complete and runnable; no infinite-scope claim.
